name: calendar-heatmap
summary: When something happens across two time scales, such as hour of day by weekday: a grid of cells shaded from light to the accent by value. Name a row, a column or both in highlight to write those cells' values.

roles.name: x
roles.doc: the column, such as the hour

roles.name: row
roles.doc: the row, such as the weekday

roles.name: y
roles.doc: the value that shades each cell, such as contacts per hour
